title: qos 01000ms.png shifted honestly (real red pipe-pressure at tick 20) but the re-bless cause-doc enumerates only qos's 65s capture — the 1s capture is an undocumented-but-real shift
evidence: Pixel diff base blob 5ce1443 vs worktree goldens/qos/01000ms.png: 'changed px: 8996 bbox x 356 913 y 355 525' (NEW colors: (232, 69, 69, 255) x4506 = warning red). The shift is HONEST: a byte-exact re-simulation of demos/qos.dem at this sha (run_init seed 3003, era 3, fixture qos, 4 draws apply_tick 3) reproduces the blessed manifest (tick 20 hash 777ec8a260a2fea7 == goldens/qos.t1 line '20 777ec8a260a2fea7') and shows at the 1000ms capture: 'tick 20 hash 777ec8a260a2fea7 ... pipe_strain[ 0:Red 1:Red 2:Red 3:Red ]  lanes[ b0: 1=6 b1: 1=6 b2: 1=6 b3: 1=6 ]  waiting>0: 0' — every lane is at the E9 bound (lane_queue_packets 6 x packet_bandwidth 30 = 180 units; 6x30/180 = 100% >= pipe_red_pct 90). The spec's enumeration covers only the 65s capture: 'qos.dem's 65 s capture gains the panel + surge-strain' (line 95) and 'qos.dem's 65 s capture (the panel + surge strain)' (line 33); the 1s capture is not listed. Node-strain at ticks 1-2 (pre-pipe no-route pile-up, waiting_ticks>0) clears at tick 3 (waiting>0: 0) — no flicker at the capture; forecast empty at tick 20 (surge window [600,3000) ticks per demand.json start_tick 1200 / forecast_lead_ticks 600), so the panel draws zero pixels — the shift is the pressure telegraph only.
detail: Not a defect in the golden: the 1s frame is genuinely saturated (era-3 baseline, pre-surge) and the manifest reproduces byte-for-byte. The re-bless cause-doc omits the 1s capture from qos's enumerated shifts, so a reader of the spec would treat this honest shift as unaccounted.
recommended_fix: Add qos's 1s capture to the re-bless enumeration in the implementation spec (era-3 baseline saturates all four lanes at the E9 bound by tick 20 — pre-surge pressure telegraph).
